findings.source_quote: “We can’t afford to win the gain that means another’s loss; / We can’t afford to miss the crown by stumbling at the cross.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace these two lines with: “Hatuwezi kumudu kupata faida inayomaanisha hasara kwa mwingine; / Hatuwezi kumudu kukosa taji kwa kujikwaa kwenye msalaba.”
findings.translation_quote: “Hatuwezi kujinufaisha kwa faida inayomaanisha hasara ya mwingine; / Hatuwezi kukosa taji kwa kujikwaa kwenye msalaba.”

findings.source_quote: “We can’t afford to play with fire, or tempt a serpent’s bite; / We can’t afford with serious heed to treat the cynic’s sneer; / We can’t afford to wise men’s words to turn a careless ear.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use: “Hatuwezi kumudu kucheza na moto, au kujihatarisha kuumwa na nyoka; / Hatuwezi kumudu kuchukulia kwa uzito dhihaka ya mkosoaji mwenye kejeli; / Hatuwezi kumudu kupuuza maneno ya wenye hekima.”
findings.translation_quote: “Hatuwezi kucheza na moto, wala kujaribu kuumwa na nyoka; / Hatuwezi kutilia maanani kwa uzito dhihaka ya mkosoaji mwenye kejeli; / Hatuwezi kuyasikiliza kwa uzembe maneno ya wenye hekima.”

findings.source_quote: Title: “Things We Can’t Afford.” Refrain: “We can’t afford…”
findings.suggested_fix: Use the consistent refrain “Hatuwezi kumudu…” and title “Mambo Tusiyoweza Kumudu.” In particular, revise the first line to “Hatuwezi kumudu kupata faida inayomaanisha hasara kwa mwingine.”
findings.translation_quote: Title: “Mambo Tusiyoweza Kumudu.” Refrain varies between “Hatuwezi kumudu…” and “Hatuwezi…”; the first line says “Hatuwezi kujinufaisha…”
